newsitem.title: USA: Phillips to build Texas petroleum pipeline.
newsitem.headline: Phillips to build Texas petroleum pipeline.

text.p: Phillips Pipe Line Co, a unit of Phillips Petroleum Co, said on Wednesday is to modify an existing pipeline and construct a new pipeline to carry petroleum products from its Borger, Texas, refinery to El Paso, Texas, and to Arizona.

The project is expected to be completed in 1998 and will involve converting and reversing an existing eight inch natural gas liquids pipeline from Borger to Gaines in Texas and constructing a 220 mile, 10 inch pipeline from Gaines to El Paso and building a new terminal at El Paso.

Tom Rich, president of Phillips Pipe Line, said the project was part of the company's strategy to expand its transportation network in the southwestern U.S. to meet growing demand for refined products.
Costs were not disclosed and the capacity has not yet been decided. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
